title: Vanishing normal defect about y gives x − y ∈ S on the whole support (printed 5.5(8))
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N and y ∈ ℝ^N. Suppose normalDefect V y (B_ρ(y)) = ∫_{B_ρ(y)×G} ofReal(|(x−y) − p_S(x−y)|²/|x−y|^{n+2}) dV(x,S) = 0 for every ρ > 0 (closed balls). Then x − y ∈ S (z.1 − y ∈ z.2.plane) for every z = (x,S) in the support of V.measure on ℝ^N × G(N,n).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (y : Euclidean N), (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → normalDefect V y (closedBall y ρ) = 0) → ∀ z ∈ V.measure.support, z.1 - y ∈ z.2.plane
